pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: top of the housing between the two foot bars (rudder mechanism)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the CLS-E MK II heli rudder seen from the front left, slightly from above: black housing with two tubular foot bars sticking out to the sides
mappingSource: catalog brunner.json (product page https://brunner-innovation.swiss/product/cls-e-mkii-heli-rudder/, which links the CLS-E MK II Rudder quick install guide https://shop.brunner-simulation.ch/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/BRUNNER_QuickInstallGuide_CLS-E-MKII-Rudder.pdf: Z axis = yaw)
note: The heli version has foot bars instead of pedal plates; no toe brakes are visible on the photo (consistent with the catalog having only the rudder part). The rudder axis is marked on top of the housing between the two bars.
